checked: watch-list found: GoTo results, Indosat AI Cloud, e-commerce digital tax, consumer phone prices, creator account hack

events.event: Hashim Djojohadikusumo of Kadin's advisory council said Shopee, Lazada, GoTo and banks/fintechs must start collecting and remitting digital taxes not previously collected from 9 November.
events.key_numbers: Start 9 Nov 2026 (per Hashim only, no DJP confirmation) · tax ratio about 12% of GDP vs 18% target in about 3 years · gap about Rp1,500 trillion/year · DJP estimate digital tax revenue +50% to about Rp16 triliun (from Rp8-12 triliun)

sources.label: Bisnis (epaper) 31 Oct headline: Pungutan Pajak Digital Diperluas

events.why_it_matters: Online sellers and buyers on marketplaces may see new tax collection within days, but the date is not yet officially confirmed.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance plus Bisnis print headline 31 Oct, Disway also covers

events.event: Windah Basudara's YouTube channel briefly showed hacker-style thumbnails and a political message, then returned to normal; netizens debated hack versus gimmick and Windah had not commented.
events.key_numbers: About 20.6 million subscribers · 30 Oct 2026 · restored same period · previous real hack July 2022
events.why_it_matters: A top creator's channel looked hijacked, a reminder of how account takeovers work and how to secure your own accounts.
events.spreading_evidence: detikInet top story 31 Oct; multiple regional outlets and X chatter

events.event: GoTo reported a Q3 2026 net profit of Rp441 billion, its third profitable quarter in a row, and raised its 2026 adjusted EBITDA target.
events.key_numbers: Net profit Rp441 miliar (vs Rp255 miliar loss a year earlier) · operating profit Rp351 miliar · revenue Rp5.6 triliun +17% · core GTV Rp194 triliun +89% · 72.5 juta annual transacting users +16% · EBITDA target Rp3.7 triliun (from Rp3.4 triliun)
events.why_it_matters: Gojek's parent turning from heavy losses to steady profit changes the story for drivers, investors and the GOTO stock.

events.event: Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison said its AI Cloud business earned about US$50 million in the first nine months of 2026, already well above all of 2025.
events.key_numbers: US$50 juta (about Rp906 miliar) in 9M 2026 · US$28 juta in FY2025 · US$33 juta in H1 2026 · FY2026 target US$100 juta (about Rp1.8 triliun) · contracted revenue from 2027 over US$300 juta
events.why_it_matters: A telco earning more from AI computing than from phone plans shows where Indonesia's data-centre boom is going.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia tech tag page top item

events.event: iBox raised prices of the iPhone 17e 512GB and iPhone 17 256GB and 512GB between 15 and 30 October.
events.key_numbers: iPhone 17e 512GB Rp17,999,000 to Rp20,499,000 (+Rp2.5 juta) · iPhone 17 256GB Rp19,999,000 to Rp20,499,000 (+Rp500 ribu) · iPhone 17 512GB Rp23,999,000 to Rp24,499,000 (+Rp500 ribu) · iPhone 18 Pro Max 256GB Rp29,499,000
events.why_it_matters: Phone prices are creeping up in Indonesia, fitting the global memory-chip squeeze.

events.event: Several big game releases land in the week of 2-8 November, including World of Warcraft: Forever (4 Nov) and Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Stellar Blade and Guardians of the Galaxy ports for Switch 2 (5 Nov).
events.key_numbers: 3 Nov Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered · 4 Nov World of Warcraft: Forever (PC) · 5 Nov Zelda: Ocarina of Time, Stellar Blade Complete Edition, Guardians of the Galaxy Encore (all Switch 2) · 8 releases in week · GTA VI 19 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Gamers get a stacked week, with GTA VI two weeks later.

events.event: Shopee's 11.11 Big Sale runs through 11 November, with Harbolnas-season promos across marketplaces.
events.key_numbers: Ends 11 Nov 2026 · flash sale from Rp11 ribu · discounts up to 90% · overlaps the planned 9 Nov digital tax start and the 50% admin fee cut for UMKM sellers (from 25 Oct)
events.why_it_matters: The biggest online shopping day of the year comes right as new marketplace tax and fee rules apply.
